desc: 暗调烧烤氛围配白底演示双轨：极速精准读数，防水耐用，全场景通用
name: 速读数显探针温度计款

shots.intent: 首图立信任：主机加礼盒加速查卡全家福，一眼看清买什么送什么
戳中凭感觉烤就是赌运气：切开牛排露出生熟不一的截面
给出硬参数：极速读数、高精度、大屏背光、磁吸收纳、温度指南
展开即开机、合拢即关机、自动休眠，消除续航焦虑
整机可冲洗加磁吸贴冰箱，解决怕洗坏与找不到两个顾虑
2x2 网格证明一表通吃：烧烤、烤箱、油炸、空气炸锅
把机身内置对照表放大成指南：各肉类各熟度一目了然
双手递接礼盒的火场氛围图，触发送礼决策
收口图：质保承诺加即开即用加热销氛围，压轴促单

style.backgroundSystem: dual track: deep brown-black ember gradients #1A0E08 to #3A1E0E with floating spark particles for emotional shots; seamless white #FFFFFF or white marble #E8E6E2 for demos and guides; white subway tile #F2F0EC for waterproof scenes
style.direction: dark charcoal BBQ atmosphere alternating with clean white info tiles; red body and cyan LCD are the only hero colors
style.iconSystem: white round chips with red-stroke line icons; steel spec plates; 2x2 grids separated by thin white lines
style.lightingSystem: warm side-backlight with rim highlights and spark particles on dark shots; soft top light with light contact shadows on white shots; LCD always glows cyan
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: dark charcoal BBQ atmosphere is the emotional spine of this suite - deep brown-black ember backgrounds #1A0E08 to #3A1E0E with floating orange sparks #E07820, always anchored by the glossy red thermometer body #D8201A and its glowing cyan LCD #3ED8E8 as the only two hero colors. Dark scenes alternate with clean white #FFFFFF or white-marble #E8E6E2 info tiles for demos and guides; waterproof scenes use white subway tile #F2F0EC and brushed steel #8A8D8F. Lighting: warm 2800-3500K side-backlight with rim highlights and spark particles on dark shots, soft top light with light contact shadows on white shots, the LCD always glowing cyan. Bold uppercase sans headlines with one red accent word, red-ring line icons on white chips, brushed-steel plates for spec claims, 2x2 grids divided by thin white lines. The red body never shifts hue, waterproof ratings and endorsements appear only when verified, and no third-party logos or sibling-brand tools may enter the frame.
noDrift: waterproof rating and endorsements only from verified facts
style.presentationRules: red body never shifts hue; LCD always reads like 149.3F; dark frames always carry spark particles; dark and white tracks alternate for rhythm; gift boxes always with a red ribbon bow
style.surfaceSystem: seamless white paper, white marble, brushed steel (grill side panel, fridge, feature plates), walnut cutting board #A97944, cast-iron grates #26282A
style.temperature: dark scenes 2800-3500K warm firelight; white scenes 5200K neutral soft
style.typography: bold uppercase sans-serif headlines with one red accent word, brushed-steel feature plates for spec claims, white chips with red-ring line icons
